source_title: Fortune in Two Old Trunks, A (Part I)
why_this_clip: A shovel lies on dry ground with the handle running from lower left to the blade at upper right. A man's foot steps in beside the blade and at about 7.0 s his hand reaches down and takes hold of the shovel. The interval starts after the dissolve that ends near 4.0 s and stops before the whip pan that begins at 7.5 s.
